title: Order Type (Order-Type-Level)
description: A category of incoming order within a sales channel (e.g. 'b2c_standard'). Imports its own structure/ and strategies/, mirroring Topology-as-Code's warehouse.schema.json pattern.

api_version.description: Schema generation this order_type document conforms to. Declared on the order_type because that is this repo's self-contained, independently loadable scope - the unit an engine loads to run one order flow, and the same role warehouse.yaml plays in Topology-as-Code. A future incompatible change to this repo's schemas raises the version instead of silently reinterpreting existing data.

imports.description: Relative paths to further YAML files (structure/, strategies/).
